title: Exact Build-Boundary Ownership Audit
objective: 將 WP-125 NEXT_WEBPACK_BOUNDARY 進一步定位到 build phase、diagnostic code、repository-relative path、import/config chain 與 ownership，不修改既有檔案。

receipt_policy.output: allowlisted code, phase, relative paths, ownership and fingerprint only

stop_conditions: target path exists or is dirty
raw logs, source snippets or dotenv content are required
failure cannot be reproduced with stable fingerprint
existing application/config/package/dependency file must be changed
network, install, DB, provider, staging, Production or deployment is required
